## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/gspc-methods-paper`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/gspc-methods-paper -p ./dataset --unzip
```

- `GSPC_METHODS_PAPER.md`
